records.statement: Documentation-only pull requests do not require a product version bump or versioned Web release validation.
Changes to code, workflows, configuration, assets, tests, or other non-documentation paths continue to require the existing versioned release contract.

The Validate Versioned Release workflow still runs for documentation-only changes but skips release-metadata and versioned-Web stages when the deterministic classifier marks the change documentation-only.
Regression coverage was added for Markdown-only changes, non-Markdown docs files, mixed documentation and production changes, and workflow changes.
